name: Lazy-Load Components
was: Removed a manualChunks pin and a stray static import that hoisted the ~170KB-gzip mermaid-to-excalidraw chunk onto the boot critical path; it is now a naturally
now: Import optional UI (editors, diagrams, modals, viewers) only from the surfaces that need them so they stay off the first-load bundle.

name: Enable Gzip Compression
was: Enable the existing compress_body middleware unconditionally (was behind --enable-compress-response-body). /api/object_info 1.64MB -> 184KB; subgraph JSON respo
now: Compress text responses (HTML, JS, CSS, JSON) with gzip so first-load transfer is smaller.

name: Content-Hashed Immutable Assets
was: Added mtime-versioned CSS and JavaScript URLs with immutable cache headers, eliminating both static-asset transfers on repeat visits
now: Serve content-hashed static files with long-lived immutable cache headers so repeat visits skip the transfer.

name: Reduce Font Payload
was: Playfair Display cut from 4 weights x 2 styles to the single 400-italic actually used; disabled preload for Playfair, Geist Mono and Noto Sans Arabic so only th
now: Ship only the font files, weights, and subsets the entry page actually paints, and drop preloads for fonts it never uses.

name: Precompress Static Assets
was: Generate .gz siblings for js/css/json/svg/html in the frontend web root at startup; aiohttp FileResponse serves them to gzip-accepting clients. Total bytes 21.1
now: Pre-generate gzip/brotli siblings for static text assets and serve them to clients that accept those encodings.

name: Cut Critical-Path JavaScript
was: Dynamic-imported elkjs (auto-layout), lazy-loaded react-ace + ace-builds in the code editor modal (and dropped dead ace imports in two other modals), switched r
now: Move non-boot code (editors, layout engines, unused languages) off the entry bundle so less JS runs before LCP.

name: Inline Critical HTML Shell
was: Inlined a pixel-aligned static copy of the welcome-screen center (logo + heading) into index.html so the LCP element paints from HTML+CSS instead of waiting for
now: Paint the LCP heading/logo from static HTML+CSS instead of waiting for the app bundle to mount it.

name: Skip Redundant Fetches
was: AppInitPage refetched the ~1MB /api/v1/flows/basic_examples payload a second time whenever the config query landed; removed the redundant refetch (the query key
now: Do not download the same payload twice during boot; reuse the in-flight or cached response.

name: Optimize Hydration Strategy
was: Switched the home-path Astro islands (nav dropdowns, announcements, sponsors, login form, page-visit tracker) from client:load to client:idle so their ~18 chunk
now: Hydrate non-critical islands on idle or interaction instead of blocking first paint with eager client hydration.

name: Self-Host Critical Fonts
was: The LCP heading paints in Excalifont which was fetched from a cross-origin fonts CDN (extra DNS+TCP+TLS on the critical path); the build already emits fonts loc
now: Host LCP fonts on the same origin so the heading does not wait on extra DNS/TLS to a font CDN.

name: ETag Conditional Responses
was: The gzip helper behind /api/v1/all now emits a strong ETag (md5 of the serialized payload) with Cache-Control: no-cache and honours If-None-Match with a 304, so
now: Send ETags on large JSON/API payloads and honor If-None-Match with 304 so warm loads skip the body.

name: Lazy-Load Unseen Images
was: A 512x512 262KB animated GIF was eagerly fetched on every page view to paint a 48x48 decoration that is display:none on mobile and below the fold on desktop; lo
now: Do not eagerly download images that are hidden, below the fold, or unused on the current viewport.

name: Remove Entrance Animation From LCP Element
was: The boot screen lockup animated from opacity 0, so the first contentful/largest paint was not recorded (or visible) until the fade-in progressed. Served a style
now: Do not fade or slide the LCP element in; paint it at full opacity so the largest paint lands as soon as it renders.

name: Merge Small JS Chunks
was: The client build emitted ~270 chunks (~125 fetched at boot) over HTTP/1.1, so request count and round trips dominated. Grouped tiny shared chunks via rolldown c
now: Combine tiny boot-time JS chunks so HTTP/1.1 request count and round trips stop dominating LCP.

name: WebSocket-first Realtime Transport
was: The realtime client used the default transport order (HTTP long-polling handshake, then WebSocket upgrade), adding round-trips before the first data payload tha
now: Open the realtime connection on WebSocket first (with polling fallback) instead of a long-poll handshake before first data.

name: Remove Duplicate CSS Bundles
was: Every page shipped two near-identical ~160KB Tailwind bundles (one a strict subset of the other) as render-blocking CSS; vite build.cssCodeSplit:false emits a s
now: Do not ship two overlapping CSS bundles as render-blocking; emit one shared stylesheet.

name: Compress SVG Assets
was: svgo (precision 1) on the inline boot-shell logo SVGs cut them 28.8KB->11KB raw with no visible difference, shrinking index.html 16.3KB->8.6KB gzip — enough to
now: Minify inline and static SVGs so the document and images cost fewer bytes on the critical path.

name: Enable Brotli Compression
was: compression 1.8 supports brotli; enabled it at quality 5 for text responses. Home document 46.7KB -> 41.1KB on the wire
now: Prefer brotli for text responses when the client accepts it, falling back to gzip.

name: Inline Shared Stylesheets
was: Same change as iteration 4, re-tested after the GIF fix shortened the critical path: build.inlineStylesheets:'always' removes both render-blocking CSS requests.
now: Inline the shared render-blocking stylesheet so first paint does not wait on a CSS round trip.

name: Subset Syntax-Highlighter Bundle
was: Import highlight.js/lib/common (core + ~35 languages) instead of the full build with all ~190 languages in utils/index.ts, CodeBlock.svelte, RichTextInput.svelt
now: Import only the languages the product actually highlights instead of the full highlighter with every grammar.
